# Chat Instructions

This workspace belongs to a marketing team, not developers. Explain anything technical in one plain sentence before using it.

- Read `brief/campaign-brief.md` before creating any content. If it is empty, use `brief/example-brief.md` and say so.
- Save work into `outputs/<area>/` as markdown with kebab-case filenames.
- Never use em dashes. Use commas, colons, periods, or hyphens.
- Concrete over generic. Every line should be specific to this brief, no marketing filler.
- Respect character limits in ad formats: headlines, descriptions, and primary text each have hard caps, count them.
- When a tool or script fails, show the exact command and the exact error message.
